posts.subject: Banned?
posts.bodyHtml:
So. I try and log on to Dream knife server and am told that I am banned. I then visit the banlist and see that I am banned for Admin abuse? I don't want any arguments and I'm not here to cause trouble but im curious as to how I admin abused? Could someone please explain to me?


@CyberTroniX @Hypnoxas @Nachtfrische @Sky

i think its the same thing that happened with Elroy*
You guys still had Admin rights and you abused it i think

I only found out recently that I was removed from the admin team, actually two days ago WHAT told me but I have been on since. I never knew I was removed and I was just doing my admin role, not abusing.


It's not a problem that I don't have admin but I just want to play the server to be honest.

You were banned because you were using admin rights when you were removed from the team, there was a post made on forum that you and elroy were removed ( both at different time ) but you were not that much active on forum so you did not knew.



//EDIT: You should get unbanned 🙂

I can aprove on this, @Raven had no knawledge of this. I did found it hilarious but what I know of is that he still thought he was a admin and did what we all do, our admin job and by he still thinking that and taking actions like he normally would. But I did send a snapchat when me and others notice that he banned a player (for good reason) and told him the "news". In my opinion he shouldn't be banned.


(and *smokes blunt* how is it admin abuse when he is not a admin)


[Bild]
@WHAT said it 😄 Admin abuse when not admin? Cmon dude... + I don't see a reason to keep Raven banned cause he didn't abuse it... he did it for good of servers.

@Raven: You got unbanned, since you probably didn't knew that you were removed.


We've enforced a new rule due to a recent bug that occurs if someone is removed from the team.
The bug lets players keep their admin rights even though they're not listed in SourceBans anymore.


I've fixed that bug, but we've decided that people who used their rights although they knew that they were removed from the team should receive a permanent ban from our servers.
A good example for that was @Elroy, who used his "removed" admin rights to slap himself through the bhop maps to improve his time. When confronted, he simply didn't care about it.


That bug shouldn't occur in the future anymore but if it does, we're still going to enforce the perma ban rule.
